notes.title: Kickstarter funded in under 24 hours! Stretch goals! London Comic Con!
notes.content:
It’s been just over a week since [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]we launched our Kickstarter[/url], and a LOT has happened. Let’s get to the biggest news first though!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/0b35631b112f415bd84c82654407b1a4d54ee1cb.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Crescent County hit its funding goal in under 24 hours.[/h2]

This is an absolutely unbelievable achievement and we are so, so thankful.

For a game idea that started out so small, and so hopeful, and seemed so utterly impossible to make real, we’re now sitting at 62k with 20 days left to go. From all of us at Electric Saint, thank you so much for all your cheering and enthusiasm and support. We crossed the line at 16:37, with more than an hour to left on the clock!

It was also CARNAGE in the Discord as we speculated on whether we’d cross the finish line before the 24 hour mark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/b7a8ed5653291509d2938a094b9243ab11314b73.png[/img]

We were screaming, we were cheering, there was much keyboard smashing. We didn’t think it was likely to happen in 24 hours at ALL, but the sheer momentum of this community’s energy carried us forward. With delight and yelling and memes. Sending you all SO MUCH LOVE!!!! And [url=https://discord.gg/mJkBhmMd8E]hop into the Discord[/url] if you’d like to get involved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/c79f17328ae3a34a277f35abc9ff7d6303212fbd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/c514b131cfd102ab9c5eb073940d71110dafb604.png[/img]

We’ve also hit our first stretch goal:

[h2]£60k: Expanded Driving Radio![/h2]

Music is such a vital moodsetter for our game, and we want to have as many vibey tracks in Crescent County as possible. With the extra funding, we can pay for more music for our in-game radio/background music (not the Spotify playlist)! Alongside creating more original music to add to our OST, we also want to license music from existing artists. We'd love for CC to act as a literal vehicle for music discovery, especially for new and upcoming local bands! This is something we're already doing in a small way, but we want to do it a WHOLE LOT MORE!

Our next stretch goal iiiiis:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/eedb8afde493a3ce2cd7abb67cb003f6c0bddbb9.png[/img]

[h2]£67k: Longer Dates, More Kissin![/h2]

With the extra funding we can put more resources and assets into our romances with Aster. Bo, Jessica, and Mara, which includes more animations (taking Jessica on a romantic ride on the back of your broom, anyone?), better date locations (bonfires on the beach, mycology research with Aster, light breaking and entering with Mara), and expanded dialogue options. We really want to create memorable romantic moments with emotional heft (any maybe even some yearning), so [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]this funding will really help us achieve that![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/bed009a3eb7981deed4d33bd005f577a6fa63d64.png[/img]

Finally, we rolled straight from our launch into demoing our game to the public at MCM London Comic Con! [i]This may have been one of the most exhausting things Anna has ever done.[/i] However, with the support of some incredible booth buddies, it was a wonderful success!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/8067df51ac4a11eb9dbdf6cbe2d1d34793148264.png[/img]

We got some amazing demo feedback that we're going to be applying alongside what we've received in our Discord demo feedback channel, and we got to have a lot of wonderful moments of long-time supporters of Anna's illustration realise that the painting on their wall [i]is a video game now.[/i] Also Gengar enjoyed the wares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/3f46693e08e4b08b36c46da78c58ee456f14a4d4.png[/img]

To top all of this off, one of our favourite motorbroom enthusiasts Alex customised a Sony Sports CD Walkman to look like a piece of witch-tech straight out of Crescent County! Honestly this is hands down one of the coolest things EVER and it has pride of place on our shelf, forever. Look!! At this!!! We must find a way to reference it in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/acadf8cc962274669695570f068348ef52e13cad.png[/img]

Anyhow, LOTS HAPPENING, LOTS MORE TO COME. We haven't even gotten into the Crescentsonas yet! As always, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]please tell your friends about our Kickstarter,[/url] please back us if you're interested, we've got so much more that we want to do! It's happening, gang, it's happening!

notes.title: Our Kickstarter is LIVE!!!
notes.content:
Hello! We're going to get right to it!!

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]Our Kickstarter campaign for Crescent County has just gone live!![/url][/h1]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/1e755bf44f261f369bf87be530226637b1fbe4e3.png[/img][/url]

This means that you can now head to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]HERE[/url] and help us make our dream game! Along the way you can nab yourself all sorts of cool swag, we’ve got digital soundtracks, ZINES, pins, patches, and even BASEBALL CAPS.

For those of you who just want to see a great game get made, please consider spreading the word of our Kickstarter or just chipping in a small amount to help us number go big.

It’s been incredibly difficult canvasing the entirety of the Games Industry for funding on this project, toeing the line between ‘needing to look cool and capable so people have confidence in us’ and ‘wanting to scream in to the void about how hard it is for indies right now’. The success of this Kickstarter will absolutely transform what we’re able to deliver as a team.

So yea. We hope you like the campaign and thank you to everyone who’s helped us get this far, you mean the world to us.

ES ⚡

notes.title: Crescent County Kickstarter Launch Date Announcement 👀
notes.content:
If you’ve had your ear to the ground, well, first of all, are you ok? And secondly, you’ve probably already heard that we’re about to launch our Kickstarter campaign! We’re feeling particularly brave today so we’ve mustered the courage to share another piece of information with you all: Our launch date! Truly, this is sacred knowledge, but we trust you with it.

So here it is!
The big announcement!
The date!

[h2]THE CRESCENT COUNTY KICKSTARTER LAUNCHES [b]TUESDAY 20TH MAY!![/b][/h2]

Assuming we timed that correctly, a huge explosion of fireworks and applause should have been audible in your imagination.

So yeah. There it is. A date! THE date!
When the Kickstarter goes live you’ll be able to back the project and see what perks and goodies we’ve lined up for anyone that pledges to the campaign. 

Until then, please do help us spread the word of the campaign - it really helps us if people [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]follow the pre-launch page.[/url] And [url=https://discord.gg/mJkBhmMd8E]come hang out in our Discord too, if you fancy it![/url]

Thank you for your continued support in motorbrooms, friend kissing and beautiful sunsets.

notes.title: We're doing a Kickstarter!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Let’s cut to the chase with this one:
[h2]Crescent County is coming to Kickstarter![/h2]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053786/4da460fac9c2ec16a584cc551685e8270c00eec3.png[/img][/url]

If you’re reading this then you can head over to our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/annahollinrake/crescent-county]pre-launch page right now[/url] to follow the campaign, find out when it goes live and be one of the first backers supporting the game (and maybe getting some cool merch when you do!)

We have a lot of faith in the power of grassroots communities. Our players, our friends and our communities have been so vocal in their support of Crescent County and now we’re putting the opportunity to make our game a reality in your hands.

We’ll offer more details as the campaign progresses but the best ways to keep up to date with us are to follow us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/electricsaint.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url], [url=http://instagram.com/electricsaint_]Instagram[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mJkBhmMd8E]Discord server[/url].

Oh and please spread the word! Marketing is very expensive and we need all the help we can get ✨

notes.title: Crescent County demo is LIVE!!
notes.content:
Hello - If you’re reading this then it means we’ve managed to accomplish the statistically unlikely: We released our Demo! We overcame fate, we overcame the odds and most of all: We overcame a bunch of bugs and errors in Unreal Engine to bring YOU, a (hopefully) playable demo of Crescent County.

Now wait a second, before you click that “install” and “provide scathing commentary on this unfinished piece of work” button, lets just manage some expectations:
[list]
[*]Demo is about half an hour long!
[*]Steam Deck is [b]not supported right now[/b] as we're having some performance issues, but we're working on it!
[*]Game very very very not finished (we just hate keeping secrets)
[*]Bugs definitely exist in the game!
[/list]

That said, we are VERY proud of what we’ve made so far and we want to share our motorbroom driving experience with you all. We know many of you are excited to explore our island whilst gliding, drift boosting and sweeping your friends off their feet (metaphorically, for now) - that’s exactly what we hope to offer in this demo.

Finally - If we’ve said it once: We’ve said it once or twice. [url=https://discord.com/invite/mJkBhmMd8E]Join our Discord Server.[/url] The development team are in there posting memes of their own characters, we have people making fanart, we have regular chats about DnD and our Community Manager regularly overshares his latest JRPG or anime obsessions. It’s paradise. We’ve also got a channel (called the “Bug Hotel”) where you can document any bugs or glitches you come across and we jump onto the voice chat to show-off development secrets or co-stream announcements and news about the game.

December is quite a packed month so you MIGHT hear from us again before the year is up, who knows 

(we're knows, we're also in the following showcases this upcoming week!! 👇👇)

Day of the Devs (Dec 9th, 12:00 EST / 17:00 GMT)
Women Led Games (Dec 11th, 19:00 EST / 00:00 GMT (midnight of the 11th and 12th))
The Game Awards for People Who Can't Afford the Game Awards (Dec 13th, 12:00 EST / 17:00 GMT)

Hopefully we'll catch you on the Discord sometime soon!
